conviction_note: abs_move 13 (event-implied 11.55, own median 10.89, max 28.7, a new Q4 guide on a +40% q/q quarter, so scaled up) times a 52% p_up: the counterparty data are mildly positive (Amazon chips triple-digit, Trainium commitments 20x, 2027 capex up at Amazon and Alphabet) and the stock is down 38% in 20 days at ~46x forward, against a name that sold its last three beats (-21.4, -0.8, -12.0) and a +6.2 put skew. The findings sum to -0.3 because the beat-and-sell history is the largest single item; the scaled number is slightly positive because the de-rating lowers the bar the Q4 guide has to clear. The gap is small and is a statement that I have no edge beyond a coin flip on direction.

Company Q3 guide $540-560m, ~72% non-GAAP GM, EPS $1.16-1.21 (Q2 8-K ex 99.1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001736297/000173629726000033/q226exhibit991.htm). Q4 bar: analysts model ~$656m (+19% q/q), per TIKR 2026-11-02 (https://www.tikr.com/blog/astera-labs-stock-fell-after-its-last-3-revenue-beats-heres-what-could-change-on-nov-3); 2026 revenue consensus $1.91bn implies Q4 ~$648-668m. The Q3 bar is sourced and agreed; the Q4 bar has one source. Revenue beat the top of guide in each of the last three quarters (Q2 $392.4m vs $355-365m guide).
positioning_check: Short interest 8.02m shares, 5.14% of float, days to cover 1.86 (previous month 9.18m), stockanalysis.com statistics page updated 2026-11-03 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/alab/statistics/), settlement date not shown. Not a crowded short; shorts slightly covered. Baseline: 25d skew +6.23 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.55 (call-heavy open interest), ATM IV 159%, event-implied move 11.55%. Run-up -16.1% over 5d, -38.3% over 20d, -50.2% from 52w high, +139.9% from 52w low. Insider selling heavy and one-way (295 sales, 0 purchases in 6 months per Quiver 2026-10-22), mostly 10b5-1.

findings.finding: Amazon, Astera's lead Scorpio X / Trainium customer and warrant holder, said on 2026-10-29 that its chips business grows at triple-digit percentages year over year, that Trainium and Graviton revenue commitments each rose more than 20x y/y, that prior-generation Trainium capacity sells at a premium to H1, that 2026 cash capex stays ~$220bn, and (per secondary reports) that 2027 capex will be 'meaningfully more'. That is a direct counterparty speaking after Astera last guided (Aug 4) and supports the ~$656m Q4 bar (+19% q/q) and a constructive 2027 tone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (Aug 4): revenue $392.4m vs $355-365m guide and a Q3 guide of $540-560m far above the ~$410-417m consensus; the stock fell 11.96%. Feb 2026 beat: -21.41%. The name has not paid for strong guides recently.
findings.why_not_priced: The day after Amazon reported, Astera fell ~11% (2026-10-30) on a sector-wide AI-capex/payback sell-off (Nasdaq -2.9%), so the market traded the macro reading of hyperscaler spend, not the read-through to Astera's lead customer's custom-silicon volumes. If it had been priced as a positive for Astera, the stock would not have under-performed the Nasdaq ~4x on that day and skew would not lean to puts.
findings.independence: Alphabet held 2026 capex $195-205bn and said capex will 'increase significantly in 2027' (CNBC 2026-10-28, https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/alphabet-googl-earnings-q3-2026.html), a separate counterparty, filed separately as a smaller finding.

findings.finding: Alphabet on 2026-10-28 kept 2026 capex at $195-205bn and its CFO said capex will 'increase significantly in 2027'; Microsoft said calendar-2026 spending ~$170bn with spending accelerating. Hyperscaler spending into 2027 rises, which supports the Aries/Taurus/Scorpio demand outlook behind Astera's next guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measurable for this line specifically; the stock fell ~11% on 2026-10-30, the day after these capex statements, so the macro reading has recently been negative.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is wire copy and the sector sold off on it (Alphabet -10% on search). Filed because the 2027 capex direction is the one input the Q4/2027 tone depends on, and Astera's own price has moved as if 2027 spend were at risk (Northland's Oct 9 downgrade thesis).
findings.independence: Proxy: macro-to-company transmission, not a statement about Astera. Different document from the Amazon finding. Also rbnenergy summary of Alphabet/Microsoft record capex: https://rbnenergy.com/daily-posts/analyst-insight/q3-2026-earnings-calls-alphabet-microsoft-report-record-capex-data

findings.finding: Astera has fallen after each of its last three revenue beats: Feb 2026 -21.41%, May 2026 -0.83%, Aug 2026 -11.96% (the last on a Q3 guide ~30% above consensus); 2 of 7 prints since IPO-era coverage rose. Q3 is guided to the consensus midpoint ($550m), so a beat to ~$575-590m is expected, and the reaction turns on the Q4 guide versus ~$656m and gross margin versus ~72%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline: -11.96, -0.83, -21.41, +1.47, +28.66, -0.38, -10.89; median |move| 10.89. Beats sold three times running.
findings.why_not_priced: The pattern is public, but the whisper EPS ($1.30) above the top of the guide shows the buy-side still expects a beat-and-raise; if the beat-and-sell pattern were fully priced the whisper would sit at guide and options would not still carry an 11.6% event move with a put skew.
findings.independence: Baseline history (8-K item 2.02 acceptance times) confirms the same moves from a different source; same underlying facts, so one finding.

findings.finding: The stock has de-rated hard into the print: -38.3% over 20 sessions and -16.1% over 5, 50% below its 52-week high, at ~46x forward earnings against a one-year average of 72x and a March low of 41x, with no company-specific negative news (falls attributed to the FT OpenAI-revenue report on Oct 8, the Northland/Citi downgrades on Oct 9, and the Oct 30 AI sell-off). The bar for the reaction is lower than in August, when the stock sat near $340-400.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2025, after a weak spell, the stock rose +28.66% on a beat-and-raise; the three most recent prints came after strong run-ups and fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by definition (it is the price). What is not visible: if the market expected a weak Q4 guide on company-level evidence, there would be a company-level trigger; none exists in the record, and the drawdown tracks sector moves. Against this, skew of +6.2 says the option market still pays for downside, so the size is held small.
findings.independence: Baseline tape (run_up_20d -38.3%, pct_from_52w_high -50.2%) confirms the drawdown; Earnings Whispers/finviz 2026-10-26 notes sentiment moved from slightly bearish to near neutral (https://finviz.com/news/408291/astera-labs-must-prove-its-40-scorpio-driven-revenue-leap-as-shares-sink-toward-lows).

findings.finding: Gross margin is falling: non-GAAP GM 76.4% in Q1, 73.7% in Q2, guided ~72% for Q3, with ~200bp a quarter from the non-cash Amazon warrant contra-revenue and the rest from lower-margin hardware modules; consensus 2026 GM 72.6% and 2027 70.9%. As Amazon's purchases scale (chips triple-digit growth), warrant vesting grows, so a Q4 GM guide below ~72% is a plausible negative inside the reported structure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 GM 73.7% (down from 76.4%) came with the -11.96% reaction, though the guide was strong; margin is the line commentators name as the real test.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly inside what the company guided (72% for Q3) and in consensus (70.9% for 2027); the unpriced part is only whether Q4 steps lower as the warrant vests faster, which no preview quantifies.
findings.independence: Q2 8-K ex 99.1 gives the ~72% GM outlook (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001736297/000173629726000033/q226exhibit991.htm). Inference about Q4 is mine.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable; insider sales have been steady through both up and down prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced and pre-planned (10b5-1); the only residual is a supply overhang into any post-print rally once the window opens. Small for that reason.

findings.independence: Northland downgrade reported separately: https://www.webull.com/news/15763733349411840. Sector framing contradicts the Amazon/Alphabet capex statements filed above; those are later-dated counterparty documents.

findings.finding: AWS raised its Q3 ASIC server shipment forecast 20-30% in July 2026, with Trainium3 motherboards shipping from May and rack mass production from July, but 3nm wafer supply may cap the full-year increase. This supports the Scorpio X lead-customer ramp, but it predates Astera's Aug 4 guide and so sits inside the guided Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Aug 4 guide that embedded it was sold (-11.96%).
findings.why_not_priced: It lands inside the guide the company gave after it, so it is mostly priced; the residual is the 3nm cap on Q4 volumes, which cuts against the upside.
